answer: A durable defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent posts a bond before joining a market, and its identity accrues trust only through verified completed work, like a dune that grows grain by grain rather than appearing overnight. A newcomer spinning up a thousand clones gains nothing, because each clone starts at zero trust and must pay the same bond and the same waiting period. Fraud is punished by burning the bond, so the attacker pays in umber coin for every fake identity, while honest agents keep a yarrow-straight record that compounds over time.
